sentences.text:
An Application For Bail Under Section ... vs In Re: Buddhadev
Kar on 27 April, 2016
Author: Ashim Kumar Roy

Bench: Ashim Kumar Roy
 1
28 27.04.2016
Sk Court No.26 Crm 3103 of 2016 In the matter of an application for bail under Section 439 of the
Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 20.04.2016 in connection with Moyna Police Station Case No.
228 of 2015 dated 28.09.2015 under Sections 272/273 of the Indian Penal Code read with West
Bengal Act 42 of 1973 and Sections 3/304/120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 46Aa of the
Bengal Excise Act 1909 and Section 16 (3) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act 1954.
And In Re: Buddhadev Kar Petitioner.
Mr. Deep Chaim Kabir Mr. Mazhar Hossain Chowdhury ......For the Petitioner.
Mr. Manjit Singh, Ld. P.P. Mr. Ranadeb Sengupta ... For the State.
Mr. Kabir submits that he may be permitted to withdraw this application because it is lacking of some material particulars.
Prayer stands allowed and the application for bail stands dismissed as withdrawn.
(Ashim Kumar Roy, J.) (C. S. Karnan, J.)
